hook.say: Borders and neighbors! Five questions, three seconds each. The map gets tricky at the end.

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is the only country that borders Portugal?
questions.fact: Their border was set in 1297 and is among the oldest in the world.
questions.sayAnswer: Spain! Their border was set in 1297, and is among the oldest in the world.

questions.q: Which two countries share the world's longest border?
questions.fact: It runs 8,891 km, including the long border between Canada and Alaska.
questions.sayAnswer: Canada and the U.S.A! Their border runs 8,891 kilometers, including the long stretch between Canada and Alaska.

questions.q: Which tiny country lies between France and Spain?
questions.fact: Andorra's two princes are a Spanish bishop and the president of France.
questions.sayAnswer: Andorra! Its two princes are a Spanish bishop, and the president of France.

questions.q: Which country is completely surrounded by South Africa?
questions.fact: All of Lesotho lies above 1,400 meters, higher than any other country.
questions.sayAnswer: Leh-soo-too! All of it lies above 1,400 meters. No other country has such a high lowest point.

questions.q: Which country is surrounded by Senegal on three sides?
questions.fact: The Gambia, mainland Africa's smallest country, is under 50 km wide.
questions.sayAnswer: The Gambia! It is the smallest country on the African mainland, and it is under 50 kilometers wide.
